```c
bag->bag_elements = MIN(MAX_BAG_ELEMENTS, count);
```

This sets `bag->bag_elements` to the number of elements in the SafeContents. But the bag was initialized with `gnutls_pkcs12_bag_init` which uses `gnutls_calloc`, so all elements are zeroed.
